text_excerpts.1:
BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING 
Friday, May 15, 2026 
12:00 p.m. 
809 Copper Ave. N.W., Albuquerque, NM  87102 
(Meeting will be Hybrid) 
 
Zoom instructions below 
 
 
AGENDA 
 
Roll Call 
 
Approval of the May 15, 2026 Agenda 
Tab 1 
Approval of the April 17, 2026 Action Summary 
PUBLIC COMMENT 
Tab 2 
Anyone who wishes to address the RMRTD Board must register with the 
Secretary of the Board (via email to bthomas@mrcog-nm.gov) at least 24 hours 
prior to the meeting. 
FINAL ACTION ITEMS 
Tab 3 
R-26-07 RMRTD 
Approval of RMRTD Budget and Capital Plan – FY2027-2031 
Tab 4 
R-26-08 RMRTD 
Approval of RMRTD FY2027 Budget 
Tab 5 
R-26-09 RMRTD 
Approval of RMRTD Open Meetings Resolution and Establishment of the 
Fiscal Year 2027 Meeting Schedule for the RMRTD Board of Directors 
Tab 6 
RMRTD Executive Director Appointment 
DISCUSSION / INFORMATIONAL ITEMS 
Tab 7 
RMRTD / NMDOT MOA  
Lawrence Real, RMRTD Vice Chair 
REPORTS 
Tab 8 
Staff Reports: 
     RMRTD 
OTHER BUSINESS AND NOTES 
Next Scheduled Meeting: Friday, June 12, 2026 at 12:00 p.m.  
Anyone requiring special accommodations is requested to notify Barbara Thomas at (505) 247-
1750 or bthomas@mrcog-nm.gov at least three days prior to the meeting.  
Zoom link on next page
